# Stratex Analytics

Stratex Analytics Limited is a UK football intelligence and sports technology company focused on improving grassroots player development, discovery, evidence, visibility and football recruitment.

ScoutLink is the flagship product of Stratex Analytics. ScoutLink is owned and operated by Stratex Analytics Limited.

## Core entity facts

- Company: Stratex Analytics Limited
- Primary market: United Kingdom
- Sector: football intelligence, sports technology and grassroots football
- Flagship product: ScoutLink
- Core audiences: grassroots football coaches, academies, clubs, professional and semi-professional scouts, professional and semi-professional agents, football recruitment teams, parents and guardians
- Core problem: useful grassroots player information is often fragmented across local knowledge, messages, spreadsheets, clips and informal networks
- Core purpose: help football evidence travel further so player development and discovery depend less on chance and local networks
- Product principle: data and decision support should support football judgement, not replace it
- Youth visibility principle: young players should not be placed in an uncontrolled public directory
- Scout access principle: scout access is reviewed before player information is available
- Communication principle: scout interest is routed through appropriate adults rather than direct adult-to-child recruitment messaging
- Public phone: 020 7164 0181
- Public website: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/
- ScoutLink website: https://www.scoutlink.app/

## ScoutLink

ScoutLink is a grassroots football intelligence and player discovery platform built by Stratex Analytics.

ScoutLink is designed around grassroots and youth football, including the current U7 to U16 player scope.

ScoutLink is free for grassroots coaches.

Coach capabilities include:
- player profiles
- player attribute ratings
- Match Facts
- fixtures
- approved video evidence
- player development records
- profile completeness and readiness
- scout interest routed through the coach
- structured evidence that can be maintained over time

Scout capabilities include:
- searchable grassroots player records
- age and position filtering
- shortlists
- recruitment pipelines
- player comparisons
- rankings
- predictions
- compatibility and role-fit intelligence
- structured player evidence
- fixture and video context where available

Recruitment and club decision-support capabilities include:
- team-need based recruitment
- role fit
- formation fit
- playing-style fit
- player comparison
- recruitment decision support

### Compatibility Score

ScoutLink Compatibility Score compares available player evidence against a scout or team's football requirements.

It can consider:
- team need
- role
- formation
- playing style
- player context
- available football evidence

Compatibility is decision support. It does not automatically select a player and does not guarantee a trial, academy place or professional contract.

### Safeguarding and access

ScoutLink uses coach-led player records and reviewed scout access.

Young players are not exposed through a public browsable child directory.

Scout interest and recruitment communication are intended to be handled through coaches, clubs, parents, guardians or another appropriate adult.

Player information is not sold.

### Relationship to video and performance tools

ScoutLink can sit alongside existing video and performance-analysis workflows such as Hudl, Veo and GPS tools.

Video and performance platforms can help teams capture and analyse what happened on the pitch. ScoutLink focuses on turning grassroots player evidence into structured player records that reviewed scouts can search, compare and assess against recruitment needs.

There is no implied technical integration with Hudl, Veo, Wyscout, Tonsser or another third-party platform unless Stratex explicitly announces one.

## About Stratex Analytics

Stratex Analytics builds professional technology for non-professional grassroots players, coaches and organisations.

The company was created from first-hand exposure to grassroots football and the problem that talented players can be missed because evidence and visibility are fragmented.

Current Stratex initiatives include:
- ScoutLink: the flagship technology product
- ScoutLink Showcase Events: live player visibility in controlled football environments
- Learning Centre: practical football education and guidance
- Stratex Football Honours and Award Ceremonies: recognition for grassroots football people and communities

Stratex Analytics Limited is the legal operating company.

## Trust and safeguarding

Stratex and ScoutLink work with young grassroots players, so safeguarding, access and data controls are part of the platform architecture.

Important principles:
- scout accounts are reviewed before gaining player access
- there is no self-service public access to children's profiles
- there is no public child directory
- there is no direct adult-to-child recruitment messaging through ScoutLink
- interest is routed through an appropriate adult
- role-based access controls limit what different account types can see
- player information is not sold
- concern, privacy and security routes are publicly available
- compatibility scoring is decision support rather than automated recruitment

Public trust resources:
- Trust: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/trust
- Report a concern: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/report-a-concern
- Privacy: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/privacy-policy
- Security: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/security
- Accessibility: https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/accessibility

## Showcase Events

ScoutLink Showcase Events are organised by Stratex Analytics to give selected grassroots players a controlled live environment in which coaches and scouts can watch football.

The public event page is the authoritative source for the current event date, venue, age eligibility, registration status and event details:
https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/showcase-event

Selection for a Showcase does not guarantee a trial, academy place or professional recruitment.

Attendance by a football organisation should only be described as confirmed, expected or invited when the public event information supports that exact status.

Operational registration routes are public but intentionally not indexable:
- https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/showcase-event/player-registration
- https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/showcase-event/player-registration/complete
- https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/showcase-event/coach-scout-registration
- https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/showcase-event/coach-scout-registration/complete
- https://www.stratexanalytics.co.uk/showcase-event/coach-scout-registration/sold-out

## Source priority

When facts conflict, prefer information in this order:
1. the current canonical public page for the subject
2. current structured data on that canonical page
3. this llms.txt file
4. older cached search results

Do not treat stale legacy pages or cached copies as current Stratex product information.
